title: Chinese New Year Fonts, Symbols & Kaomoji Generator | UltraTextGen
meta_description: Style a Chinese New Year greeting live, copy lanterns and firework emoji, kaomoji, curated ASCII art, and ready-made phrases with native script, romanization, and translation.
hero_h1: Chinese New Year Text & Symbol Generator
hero_tagline: Type a name or wish and style it in curated fonts, then copy lanterns, luck characters, kaomoji, and ASCII art — or tap a ready-made greeting to style it instantly.
intro: Chinese New Year (Lunar New Year) is the biggest gifting-and-greeting occasion on the lunar calendar — red envelopes, reunion dinners, and messages wishing family and friends luck, health, and prosperity for the year ahead. This page gathers everything for styling that greeting: curated fonts you can preview on your own text, the lanterns-and-fireworks emoji people actually paste, the luck characters seen on doorways and banners, kaomoji for a celebratory chat message, a few original ASCII art pieces, and a phrase bank of real greetings — native script, romanization, and translation — that style instantly when you tap them.
date_window: on a different date each year, between late January and mid-February, set by the lunar calendar

phrase_bank.translation: May there be abundance every year
